unit: Engineering-only offline observed-execution receipt intake, independent from optimizer scoring, with journal idempotence and immutable checkpoint binding.
hypothesis: A strictly causal, self-financed receipt tape with 180-day development and a disjoint sealed holdout declaration can be checked and journaled without promoting modeled OHLC prices to observed fills, opening sealed M10 finals, changing original M9 costs/caps, or claiming receipt provenance authenticity.
alternate: A source-tape schema or journal can be internally consistent but cannot prove broker provenance; if no externally fixed evidence root or observed source exists, gate remains blocked.
finite_fixture_catalog: valid offline single entry/exit receipt ledger and 180 contiguous calendar development days
two partial exit fills conserve quantity, fees and net
missing terminal fill and open inventory fails
future-known signal or exit label fails
duplicate event identifier and duplicate order label fail
modeled OHLC source rejected even if renamed OBSERVED
wrong native checkpoint binding or SHA-256 expected anchor fails
holdout overlap or fewer than 180 development days fails
identical restart idempotent on SQLite journal; conflicting restart fails
corrupted SQLite audit chain fails closed
large input bounds, negative/NaN fees and invalid decimals fail
refutation: Any receipt effective_at later than known_at gets accepted
Any output generated without full inventory/fee reconciliation is eligible to enter recursive.tick
Any modeled OHLC receipt is labeled real observed
Any holdout sample or older M10 sealed final is accessed
Any rejected/corrupted journal changes trial budget or audit without error
Any missing trusted source anchor is interpreted as source authenticity
Any source files under frozen M9/M10 are overwritten
Any economic search, broker/market order, deployment, PR merge occurs
pre_validation_rule: Only synthetic engineering fixtures for schema/testing, never optimization candidates. Observed provenance cannot be inferred from self-declared fields or SHA equality. No prospective validation starts.
versioning: Append-only sources, protocol must remain immutable; corrective protocols use new paths.
